violations.description: INSECT RODENT ANIMAL CONTROL (3 pts): Flies were observed landing on food preparation surfaces and inside an uncovered bucket of pizza sauce. Ecolab recently installed fly traps and this violation will be correced to give a short period to allow the corrective measure to take effect. However if the problem does not improve within the next couple of days please contact Ecolab or another pest control provider to implement additional control measures such as installing a fly light trap. In the meantime all food and food-contact surfaces must be protected from insects until the problem is resolved. It is strongly recommended that the pizza sauce currently on the food preparation counter be discarded due to active contamination by flies.

FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Ceiling in the kitchen noted with open ceiling tile. Also the security camera some vent covers and some areas of the ceiling were noted in need of cleaning. White tile wall over prep coolers also noted in need of cleaning.
TOILET FACILITIES (1 pts): Toilet room door noted not self closing.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (1 pts): Rolling black carts and fan guards in the walk-in cooler noted not clean.

REFUSE STORAGE (1 pts): Exterior recyclables and garbage dumpsters/containers noted not covered with a tight fitting lid. Lids for one of dumpsters are trapped behind the dumpster preventing employees from closing it after use.
EMPLOYEE PRACTICES (1 pts): A personal beverage was observed in an improper location. A beverage can was noted on a stainless prep table in the kitchen.
